patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Sellfy and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Wix's shape. Choose Wix only if your buying job matches “Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell onlin” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Wix leans checkout-conversion, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Wix is Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell online), Business $39, Business Elite $159 (annual tile.
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Wix (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Wix-leaning checkout-conversion, catalog-management, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Wix — Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B.
